newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said.
Inquiry was firm and demand light.
Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers Thursday. For the week to date 83,700 head confirmed including 28,700 head or about 34 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 67.00.
Confirmed - 300 week ago - holiday year ago - 8,700
Wk to date - 83,700 week ago - 71,000 year ago - 39,400
